title: The Nutcracker

vibeProfile.oneLine: A nutcracker wakes on Christmas Eve and carries a girl into wonder.

summary: On Christmas Eve, a girl's new nutcracker comes to life to lead her toys into battle against the Mouse King, then carries her off to a kingdom of sweets. E.T.A. Hoffmann's strange, enchanting original is darker and odder than the famous ballet it inspired, a proper Romantic fairy tale full of the uncanny alongside the wonder. This clothbound edition restores Hoffmann's own tale, a perfect small piece of Christmas magic for readers of any age.
whyReadIt: The strange, enchanting original behind the ballet, darker and odder than you expect. A perfect Christmas Eve read.

funFacts.text: Hoffmann's 1816 tale is the source Tchaikovsky's beloved ballet is based on.
